title: All about aRboretum
text: aRboretum integrated R package designed automate production botanical collection labels, taxonomic data extraction interactive web labels print-ready QR codes. can used arboreta, botanic gardens, educational trails, living plant collections. package offers: multilingual output Portuguese, English, French, Spanish; synonym resolution integration data Flora e Funga Brasil (FFB) World Checklist Vascular Plants (WCVP), backbone Plants World Online (POWO); global conservation status IUCN Red List; browser-based guides review retrieved data edit species phrases; interactive HTML labels species information, text--speech, distribution maps, photo slideshows, optional personal audio recordings; searchable minisite index linking generated labels; printable QR-code labels different layouts; one flexible additional language slot community-based accessibility add_lang. functions designed work together. vignette provides technical overview package workflow, main arguments, expected data structure, common customisation options.
